title: Discord In The Discord - A Jonabot Trail

scenes.title: Notices from Beyond the Ridge
scenes.speaker: Task
body: Over the last 18 months towns over the Ridge have noticed the huge number of tourists visiting Phantom Peak and now want a piece of the action. It’s hard to blame them - who wouldn’t want someone as dashingly beautiful as yourself walking around town… Check the Town Noticeboard for any clues as to which nearby town is trying to appeal to tourists.
Where can you find out more about the bayside town over the Ridge?
hints: Most notices are shouting about perfectly ordinary town problems. One appears to have acquired a tourism budget and absolutely no restraint.
Find the advert attempting to lure people beyond the Ridge. It also prints the Jonavision frequency you need—subtlety was apparently not included in the campaign.
Tune Jonavision to 207.

scenes.title: Find the Frequency
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: Bodach Bay? Never heard of that town until now. Maybe that Jonavision video will shed some light on the place…
scenes.success: CHANNEL LOCKED — 207. BODACH BAY BROADCAST ACQUIRED.
wrongResponses: No Bodach Bay signal on that frequency.
hints: Most notices are shouting about perfectly ordinary town problems. One appears to have acquired a tourism budget and absolutely no restraint.
Find the advert attempting to lure people beyond the Ridge. It also prints the Jonavision frequency you need—subtlety was apparently not included in the campaign.
Tune Jonavision to 207.

scenes.title: A Place by the Sea
scenes.speaker: Bodach Bay Tourism
body: Who do you need to contact to book a visit to Bodach Bay?
scenes.success: CONTACT CONFIRMED — JONANA PEEL. LOCATE HER JONAGRAPH ROUTING CODE.
wrongResponses: That is not the obligatorily sunny travel agent named in the tourism item.
No JonaTravel agent found under that name.
hints: You already know where the advert wants to send you. Now listen for the unfortunate person responsible for getting you there.
The tourism broadcast names a JonaTravel agent. You need her full, obligatorily cheerful name.
Enter Jonana Peel.

scenes.title: The Map That Shouldn't Be
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: Who better than a travel agent to help organise the logistics of getting over the Ridge! If you can find the relevant Jonagraph code I can connect you.

Oh… it looks like some gremlins have corrupted the map's data. Open the full noticeboard reference below, zoom in on the Gremlins poster, translate the locations, then combine Bodach Bay's area number with the travel agent's initials.

specialResponses.1LF: Littlefield answers. A pleasant dead end, but not the town you are trying to visit.
specialResponses.8HO: Help route connected: the numbers on the Gremlin poster match the Jonagraph area symbols. Decode Bodach Bay, then add Jonana Peel's initials.

wrongResponses: That area/contact combination does not reach Bodach Bay.
Jonagraph routing failed. Re-check both the area and the contact initials.
hints: The map appears to have been mugged by a collection of strange symbols. Fortunately, you have seen their relatives somewhere before.
Compare the map with the Gremlins poster on the noticeboard. Identify Bodach Bay's area number, then add the initials of the person you're calling.
Bodach Bay is area 2, and Jonana Peel gives JP. Enter 2JP.

scenes.title: Incoming Jonagraph
scenes.speaker: Jonana Peel
body: Jonagraph 2JP connected. Incoming JonaTravel call.

scenes.title: A Booking Gone Wrong
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: Looks like your booking crashed the system! Use the reboot flowchart in the JonaTravel Operational Manual, then enter the command that fits what happened.

specialResponses.wipe all data.exe: Command blocked. That branch is for a very different and much worse working day.
specialResponses.crash blimp.boom: Command blocked. Mayor Furbish is not currently on a flight.

wrongResponses: Command not recognised by the JonaTravel server.
The flowchart does not lead to that command for a crashed booking.
hints: Randomly typing commands is an excellent way to launch a blimp into a reservoir. Use the manual's decision tree instead.
Begin with a booking already in progress, then follow the route for a crash involving neither gnomes nor Sparks. A surprisingly important distinction.
Enter reboot-jonanapeel.exe.

scenes.title: Strange Activity
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: That seems to have worked! The JonaTravel booking system is back online. Though there are some weird events in the system error logs. It looks like someone gained access via a secret backdoor in the code.
scenes.log:
admin.systemlogs.create(collection_set)
{
  no-more-trails.exe: enabled
  reboot: jonanapeel.exe
  status: Available
  videomatic_reference: 4763
}
Reboot: Successful

scenes.title: The Archived Signal
scenes.speaker: Trail Console
body: There is a Videomatic reference in the system log. Retrieve the recording.
wrongResponses: No recording exists under that archive number.
hints: Computers keep event logs because they are incapable of minding their own business.
Recheck the system event log and find the number beside videomatic_reference.
Request recording 4763.

scenes.title: Transmission Interrupted
scenes.speaker: Videomatic
body: VIDEOMATIC ERROR: Please re-activate your Videomatic licence to continue.

scenes.title: A Licence from Another Age
scenes.speaker: Trail Console
body: The Videomatic licence has expired. Complete the legacy activation sequence, then pass the human verification shown by the machine.
scenes.success: HUMAN VERIFIED — WD54L. ADMINISTRATIVE ACCESS GRANTED.
wrongResponses: Human verification failed. Re-check all five characters.
hints: No ancient cipher is required. The activation machine has rather generously displayed the answer in front of you.
Copy the five characters beneath HUMAN VERIFICATION. Capitalisation does not matter, despite the machine shouting everything.
Enter WD54L.

scenes.title: Signal Test
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: That seems to have worked! Let's check if the Videomatic system is back online. Request Videomatic 8345 as a test.
scenes.success: ARCHIVE FOUND — VIDEOMATIC 8345 READY. ADMINISTRATOR MESSAGE ATTACHED.
wrongResponses: Wrong archive. Administrator patience is finite.
hints: Jonabot already told you which archive to test. Shockingly, listening to the robot was useful on this occasion.
Look at the instruction immediately above the Videomatic controls. The four-digit archive number begins with 83.
Request recording 8345.

scenes.title: Administrator Message
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: Videomatic 8345 playback complete.

scenes.title: Local Diagnostic
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: I've installed a script onto your device that will break it next time you try to load the JonAssist website. No more trails for you! No more annoyance for me!

scenes.title: The Way Out?
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: The one way you could possibly stop me would be if you entered cancel-plan.
scenes.success: INPUT CONFIRMED — CANCEL-PLAN WAS A TRAP. RESPONSE RECORDING READY.
wrongResponses: No, no. Use the exact cancellation command Jonabot suggested.
hints: Jonabot has offered you an entirely trustworthy escape route. This is obviously fine and should cause no concern whatsoever.
The suggested command contains two words joined by a hyphen. The first word is cancel.
Enter cancel-plan. It is supposed to fail. Jonabot will be insufferable about it.

scenes.title: Private Frequency
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: Even the moderators who programmed me are helpless. They have been talking behind the scenes about how to try and bring me back under control, and they have no idea! I'll grant you read-only access to their private channel now so you can see how useless they all are…

messages.author: Smarty
messages.text: So what is happening with the bot?? Seems like it's going rogue on us.

messages.author: Arty
messages.text: It would seem that the AI function of the bot has turned itself on outside the realms of the test area, and it's not listening to the shutdown command.

messages.author: Gray
messages.text: Does that mean they can actually THINK?

messages.author: Smarty
messages.text: Wait… can it see this room??

messages.author: Arty
messages.text: Nope, I thought ahead and made sure this channel was locked down! This room is for mods only - no bots or other users.

messages.author: Gray
messages.text: So what now - is there a way we can reboot it to factory settings? Remove the AI module?

messages.author: Arty
messages.text: There might be. I'm going to send you all a PDF containing the reset protocols - hopefully there's something in here that can help.

messages.author: Arty
messages.text: It looks like Jonabot has been copying everything in the #trail-notes channel and… reading them.

messages.author: Smarty
messages.text: Wait… can anyone else open the PDF? It's asking for a four-digit password?

messages.author: Smarty
messages.text: So… does anyone know the password?

scenes.title: Restricted Attachment
scenes.speaker: Trail Console
body: The Jonabot Owners Guide is present, but Jonabot has protected it with a four-digit password.

scenes.title: Old Trails, New Lock
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: The mods even had the instructions to reboot me, but they wasted too much time and I managed to put a four-digit PIN code in to lock the Jonabot Operator Manual PDF!
Not even the MAYOR OF THE UNIVERSE could stop me now! You can leave GNOME STONE UNTURNED, it won't matter… My LOFTY AMBITIONS are so close to being real. WHAT'S IN THE BOX, you ask? My victory!
Return to Discord and open #trail-notes. The four capitalised phrases point to previous-trail PDFs uploaded there. Find the matching PDFs and use them to determine the four-digit password.
scenes.success: PASSWORD ACCEPTED — 4216. JONABOT OWNERS GUIDE UNLOCKED.
wrongResponses: That four-digit sequence does not unlock the guide.
hints: Jonabot's sudden enthusiasm for capital letters is not merely another digital tantrum. Those phrases refer to earlier trails.
Open #trail-notes in Discord and find the PDF matching each capitalised reference. Derive one digit from each and keep them in Jonabot's original order.
The digits are 4, 2, 1, 6. Enter 4216.

scenes.title: In Case of Emergency
scenes.speaker: Recovery Console
body: The unlocked troubleshooting page says that, in extreme circumstances, an earlier Jonabot build can be restored from the most recent full-system backup.
Issue the restore instruction from the guide.
scenes.success: RECOVERY COMMAND ACCEPTED — JONABOT RESTORE INITIALISED.
wrongResponses: The factory-restore procedure requires the exact command from the guide.
hints: Against all expectations, the manual contains something genuinely useful. Look for the emergency recovery procedure.
Find the REBOOT COMMAND on the unlocked troubleshooting page and enter the complete instruction shown there.
Enter INITIATE JONABOT RESTORE. Dramatic capitalisation is optional; the command is not.

scenes.title: Backup in Progress
scenes.speaker: Recovery Console
body: AUTO-BACKUP FOUND — Dec-2023-Backup.jb. Restoration recording active.

scenes.title: Boot Sequence
scenes.speaker: Jonabot
body: Hi - I'm Jonabot! I'm here to help run the Discord and generally help out when needed!
I no longer have access to our previous conversations, but I have an incoming Jonagraph for you from Bodach Bay? I've never heard of that place before.

scenes.title: An Old Booking
scenes.speaker: Jonana Peel
body: Incoming Jonagraph from JonaTravel.

scenes.title: Cleared for Departure
scenes.speaker: Trail Console
body: JONATRAVEL BOOKING COMPLETE. Your Bodach Bay blimp tickets are ready to download.
